purpose: Every new candidate bundle gets one complete nonblind adversarial read before it can be called ready. Reviews add no blind vote and never approve or apply anything.
pool_rule: A row enters when every proposed field has state agreement_pending_adversarial_review and the current FLoRA value still equals the frozen value. Already-equal rows are no-ops; third values and unresolved identities stay held.

reviewer.independence: Never saw these outputs during coding; receives both role values and all recorded flags.

complete_read_rule: All registered chunks must be served through adversary_read.py, which appends a hashed receipt. Missing chunks fail validation.
supported_requires: same_finding true for the row's original
at least one supporting quotation and one strongest-counterevidence quotation, each literal in the registered source
a literal replacement quotation of at most 1500 characters with a section label
an explicit answer to any recorded parent flag
every proposed field addressed by name with the proposed value

canaries.negative: Two proposals already withdrawn after source review, plus two planted wrong proposals built from rows where both roles keep the frozen value.
canaries.positive: Two reviewed outcome corrections from the protected export.
canaries.note: Canaries are mixed into the same stream under opaque request ids. Their results never enter the ledger.

stop_rules.rule: Any negative canary returned as supported: stop launching, inspect the prompt and every result in that batch.
Both positive canaries rejected: stop launching and inspect.
More than 20 percent of the first 30 completed reviews fail mechanical validation: stop and fix before continuing.
A reviewer reports corrupted text or embedded instructions in a source: hold that bundle, keep going.

QA tripwire after the full pass: 15 randomly chosen supported bundles get a fresh second read. One flip holds that bundle and doubles the sample. Two or more flips hold the entire new supported set for human review.

qa_note: Zero errors in 15 is weak evidence by itself, so the sample is a tripwire and never a certificate.
held_scope: Provider-held 0366/0367/0374/0375/0463/0464/0465 and source-order 0096 are never served. Header-only 0656/0662 stay out.
